name: seeded-flowlines
title: Seeded Flowlines
description: A deterministic Canvas field of directional lines with short, quiet trails and a complete static state.

accessibility.notes: The canvas is decorative and aria-hidden. It pauses outside the viewport and in hidden documents, and keeps a static field for reduced motion.

performance.budget: Canvas 2D at 20 fps; 34 static paths are rasterized on resize, each frame blits that cache and paints at most 272 short trail segments; DPR is capped at 1.5 desktop and 1 mobile.
